morning.title: What happens every morning
morning.text: At {{wake}} the PC wakes and opens MuMu and the Vinhomes app. At {{start}} it books the slots chosen, usually within 15 seconds.
morning.needsText: sleep rather than shut down, stay signed in to Windows, and be plugged in if it is a laptop.

notRunning.question: Nothing ran this morning
notRunning.answer: The PC was shut down instead of asleep, or signed out of Windows.

slotFull.question: It says "{{slotFull}}"
slotFull.answer: Someone booked that slot first. Choose another on the ticket.

quota.question: The flat used up its bookings
quota.answer: 8 slots a month at most. Cancel the ones you do not need in the Vinhomes app.

loggedOut.question: The app was logged out
loggedOut.answer: Log in again in MuMu, then do one dry run.
